cases.name: prod sql select via heredoc
user: Check how many sessions were created in the last three days in the prod database, per day.

input.command:
ssh prod-proxy 'sudo -n docker exec -i app_db psql -U app -d app -P pager=off' <<'SQL' 2>&1 | head -60
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, count(*)
FROM sessions
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '3 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SQL
